_comment: Each step of the Azure security kit, with the NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls whose statements it supports and the FedRAMP 20x Key Security Indicators. The step-to-control and control-to-KSI pairs are the Azure Security Engineering guide's 'Federal requirements and KSIs' table (read from fedramp.gov's 2026 KSI theme pages and SP 800-53 on November 11, 2026); EVIDENCE, PLAN and RB reuse the provider notices kit's verified pairs (CA-7 to KSI-MLA-EVC, AU-9 to KSI-MLA-OSM, CM-3 to KSI-CMT-LMC and KSI-CMT-RVP, CP-2 to KSI-RPL-ARP); PRE reuses the privileged access workbook's AC-6 to KSI-IAM-ELP. KSIs are FedRAMP's indicators for cloud service providers: the agency lines its own evidence up with what its providers report against them and doesn't report KSIs itself. Which step supports which control is the program's reading (design guidance); the agency's assessor decides. 'stages' lists the steps each stage's evidence must hold before the go/no-go.

AU-6.title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting

SC-7(5).title: Boundary Protection | Deny by Default — Allow by Exception

EDGE.title: Front Door, Application Gateway and the origin (guide Step 5)

DRIFT.title: Compare two runs: new, fixed and still open (guide Steps 9 and 10)

METRICS.title: The guide's metrics from a run (guide Step 10)

EVIDENCE.title: Record the run as hashed, chained evidence

PRE.title: Preflight: settings, cloud, sign-in and the reader's role

RUN.title: Scheduled run: every check, the register, the comparison and the metrics

PLAN.title: Plan the security initiative's assignment in DoNotEnforce
